items.title: Port the confirmed-failing repro into a durable red test (wrapper-root + custom storyDir metadata-only commit)
items.context: Repro-first evidence: probe rp-mr1fmmur-clkpwd, review rr-mr1forp4-nbl96r (red-reviewed/target-bug), spike sr-mr1fp8ob-6k3tki. Turn the scratchpad repro into a permanent test driving captureReviewRunSnapshot + checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit: control (correct metadataRoot) fresh, production path stale after a metadata-only commit to the custom storyDir. Test MUST fail before the fix.
items.userSees: Running the new test prints its PASS line; before the fix it fails with the false-stale assertion.

happy.desc: Test reproduces control=fresh and production-path=stale on the wrapper-root+custom-storyDir metadata-only-commit before the fix, and fresh after

edge.desc: Legacy review run without workspaceBinding stays fresh (projectRoot fallback) in the test

adversarial.desc: Plain-repo/default-storyDir case in the test is byte-identical (no behavior change)

items.title: Production fix: thread metadataRoot through captureReviewRunSnapshot + diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot
items.context: handlers/review-run.ts:102 passes signedWorkspaceRoot only. Add a metadataRoot param to captureReviewRunSnapshot AND diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot (core/review-run.ts:310,265) and pass workspace.metadataRoot || ctx.root so run.materialHash/storyFilesHash + workspaceBinding sign with the storyDir-aware exclusion set. Default metadataRoot=projectRoot keeps plain repos byte-identical. Spike caveat: diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot only uses it for the EMPTY_MATERIAL_HASH diagnostic but thread it for consistency.
items.userSees: In a wrapper-root project with a custom storyDir, review_run_start signs material/story hashes that exclude the storyDir; plain repos unchanged.

happy.desc: captureReviewRunSnapshot(root, metadataRoot) excludes the custom storyDir from materialHash/storyFilesHash

edge.desc: Default metadataRoot=projectRoot keeps plain-repo snapshot byte-identical

adversarial.desc: diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot also threaded so diagnostic materialHash matches capture

items.title: Consumer fix: thread run.workspaceBinding?.metadataRoot ?? projectRoot into the two freshness checks
items.context: assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence (core/review-run.ts:686) and validateEvidenceRunBinding (core/review-run.ts:826) pass signedProjectRoot as the metadataRoot arg. Change arg4 to run.workspaceBinding?.metadataRoot ?? projectRoot while keeping gitCwd=signedProjectRoot. Binding already persists metadataRoot (types.ts:1752, handler:110). Legacy runs without workspaceBinding fall back to projectRoot (behavior unchanged).

items.title: Regression guard: prove plain/default byte-identical + lock wrapper-root custom-storyDir path; turn red test green; lattice validate
items.context: Spike mandate: signatures of pre-existing wrapper-root+custom-storyDir runs WILL change (were wrong before). Guard must prove (a) plain/default-storyDir snapshot+freshness stay byte-identical (no divergence vs DONE gate semantics) AND (b) the wrapper-root+custom-storyDir metadata-only-commit path stays fresh. Confirm CHK-001 red test now passes. lattice validate all green.
